appraisal_events.evidence: elle avait renoncé à prendre la peine de pouffer effectivement et se livrait à la place à une mimique conventionnelle qui signifiait, sans fatigue ni risques pour elle, qu'elle riait aux larmes... M. Verdurin... riant pour de bon s'essoufflait vite et avait été distancé et vaincu par cette ruse d'une incessante et fictive hilarité
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator exposes Mme Verdurin's famous hilarity as a calculated, effortless mime rather than genuine laughter, comically undercutting her sincerity; in the same stroke this practiced ruse is shown explicitly outpacing and defeating her husband, who exhausts himself trying to laugh for real.

status_effects.explanation: Her celebrated mirth is revealed as a practiced, artificial performance rather than genuine feeling, comically deflating her sincerity.
M. Verdurin is explicitly described as outpaced and defeated by his wife's laughing ruse after his own attempts at genuine laughter left him winded, losing their long-running rivalry in amiability.
